title: Circuit Oracle: Automating Attribution Graph Analysis via Natural-Language Queries
abstract: arXiv:2611.00420v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attribution graphs, an emerging tool in mechanistic interpretability, use transcoders to decompose language model computations into sparse interpretable features connected by causal edges. However, turning a graph into a safety-relevant insight requires hours of manual analysis by experts. We introduce Circuit Oracle, an off-the-shelf LLM equipped with a multi-agent harness and task-specific authored skills, which answers natural-language questions about a target model by reading the attribution graph through tool calls. We evaluate it on three safety-relevant proxy tasks: detecting spurious features in probe circuits, eliciting hidden knowledge from taboo-finetuned models, and suppression jailbreaking via feature-level interventions. Beyond task scores, the oracle produces pruned subgraphs and context-specific feature explanations that we assess qualitatively. Results are mixed. On spurious-feature detection, Circuit Oracle reaches 78.2

translated_title: 电路神谕：通过自然语言查询自动化归因图分析
translated_abstract: 归因图是机制可解释性领域的一种新兴工具，它使用转码器将语言模型的计算分解为由因果边连接的稀疏可解释特征。然而，要把一张图转化为与安全相关的洞见，需要专家进行数小时的人工分析。我们提出了Circuit Oracle，这是一个现成的大语言模型，配备了多智能体框架和针对具体任务编写的技能，它通过工具调用读取归因图，从而回答关于目标模型的自然语言问题。我们在三个与安全相关的代理任务上对其进行了评估：检测探测电路中的虚假特征、从经过禁忌微调的模型中引出隐藏知识，以及通过特征级干预实现抑制式越狱。除了任务得分之外，该神谕还会生成剪枝后的子图和结合具体上下文的特征解释，我们对这些结果进行了定性评估。结果是好坏参半的。在虚假特征检测方面，Circuit Oracle达到了78.2……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Circuit Oracle，通过多智能体框架和任务技能让现成大语言模型能够自动读取归因图并用自然语言回答关于目标模型的安全相关问题，将原本需要专家数小时人工分析的机制可解释性工作自动化。
en_tdlr: Circuit Oracle automates mechanistic interpretability by equipping an off-the-shelf LLM with a multi-agent harness that reads attribution graphs via tool calls, enabling it to answer natural-language questions about a target model's safety-relevant behaviors without hours of manual expert analysis.
